verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a Marketing API whose root links to all resources, an account export endpoint, and campaign reports with open and click rates. Transactional webhooks push engagement events (open, click, bounce, etc.) that a developer could pipe into a warehouse. However, nothing in the pack shows a campaign reports API endpoint or automation/flow metrics exposed through the API, so the API path to performance data is only implied. Marketing webhooks are also plan-gated and cover subscription and campaign-sending events rather than performance metrics. Missing for 10: a documented campaign reports/metrics API endpoint, a documented automation (flow) performance API, warehouse/dashboard export guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.
